name: NRE 5370
title: Population Dynamics
description: How population dynamics models are used in science and in the management of fish and wildlife populations, factors influencing population dynamics. Design, evaluation, and use of a population model. Students will complete activities in the R scripting language. Taught concurrently with NRE 4370.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: STAT 1100Q, MATH 1060Q or higher, and NRE 3345.
